candidates.tagline: The 'no social media' phone where WhatsApp is in the promo photo
candidates.story: Commodore's $499 Callback 8020 flip phone launched June 2026 marketing itself as an OS-level social-media blocker — but the official press photo shows WhatsApp open on-screen, and the spec sheet confirms it runs 99% of all Android apps.
candidates.why_funny: A phone sold specifically to cure social media addiction literally displays WhatsApp in its own marketing photography.
candidates.alt: Two views of a translucent aqua-blue retro flip phone: open left showing WhatsApp conversations on screen, closed right showing Commodore Callback branding with LED dot-matrix display

candidates.tagline: Samsung's $3,500 fridge has no handle — just tell it to open and hope for Wi-Fi
candidates.story: Samsung's 2026 Bespoke AI Family Hub refrigerator removes the physical handle entirely, requiring voice commands or palm-tapping a sensor to open it; consumer groups named it 'Worst in Show' at CES 2026, and BGR named it a top disappointment of the year in June 2026, noting that if you lose internet you also lose the ability to open your fridge.
candidates.why_funny: A $3,500 appliance whose designers solved the humble handle problem by requiring a stable broadband connection to access your own leftover pizza.
candidates.alt: Modern Samsung 4-door white refrigerator with no handle, flush with wood-paneled kitchen cabinetry, small touchscreen displaying abstract art where a door handle would normally be
